newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes stable, bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes stable, bearish sentiment.

text.p: Singapore bunker suppliers maintained their recent offer levels on Wednesday amid lack of market-inspiring factors, traders said.
There were some enquiries but trading willingness was low, traders said. "Suppliers may have to cut their offers slightly later to attract buyers," said one trader.
The 380-cst grade was quoted at $98/$99 per tonne and the 180-cst was at around $105. MDO and gas oil were quoted around $190 and $200 respectively.
